Private villa design — Jeddah

Private villa design in Jeddah

If you own a plot in Jeddah and plan to build your villa, you need a designer who understands the land, privacy, and how your family lives. WB Studio is a boutique studio designing private villas in Jeddah and across the Gulf — from the first idea to build-ready drawings.

Request a free call WhatsApp

Who we design for

We work with landowners, families and private investors who want a considered villa, not a repeated template. Every project gets the designer’s direct attention, not a production line.

From concept to construction

The path starts with a study of the plot, privacy and solar orientation, then an architectural concept and interior atmosphere, through to a design package that leads consultants and contractors clearly and reduces clashes on site.

Frequently asked questions about private villa design

How do I start designing my villa in Jeddah?

Send the plot location, area and your general idea via WhatsApp or the form. We start with a free call and a free preliminary concept before any paid agreement.

Do you design for plots in any Jeddah district?

Yes — North Jeddah, Obhur, premium districts and beyond. We account for building regulations, privacy and the character of each district.

Can we work together if I’m outside Jeddah?

Absolutely. We serve clients across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf remotely via video calls and shared drawings, with the same clarity.
